question: 求 $\lim_{x\to +\infty}\left[\sqrt[k]{(x + a_1)(x + a_2)\cdots(x + a_k)} - x\right].$
answer: \sqrt [ k ]{(1 + a _ {1} t) (1 + a _ {2} t) \cdots (1 + a _ {k} t)} - 1 = \sqrt [ k ]{1 + \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {k} a _ {i}\right) t + o (t)} - 1 \sim \frac {1}{k} \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {k} a _ {i}\right) t + o (t).

steps.text: 分析 这是 $\infty -\infty$ 型，令 $x = \frac{1}{t}$ ，通分化为 $\frac{0}{0}$ 型，再用等价无穷小替换.
\text {原式} = \lim _ {t \to 0 ^ {+}} \frac {\sqrt [ k ]{(1 + a _ {1} t) (1 + a _ {2} t) \cdots (1 + a _ {k} t)} - 1}{t}.

(1 + a _ {1} t) (1 + a _ {2} t) \dots (1 + a _ {k} t) = 1 + \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {k} a _ {i}\right) t + \left(\sum_ {1 \leqslant i <   j \leqslant k} a _ {i} a _ {j}\right) t ^ {2} + \dots + (a _ {1} a _ {2} \dots a _ {k}) t ^ {k},

\sqrt [ k ]{(1 + a _ {1} t) (1 + a _ {2} t) \cdots (1 + a _ {k} t)} - 1 = \sqrt [ k ]{1 + \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {k} a _ {i}\right) t + o (t)} - 1 \sim \frac {1}{k} \left(\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {k} a _ {i}\right) t + o (t).
